description.value: Backcountry Brewing is a craft brewery, tasting room, and kitchen that opened in Squamish in 2017, winning 'Rookie of the Year' at the BC Beer Awards with medals for all three core beers. The 70s ski cabin-inspired tasting room pairs an inventive menu of pizzas, salads, and snacks with more than 50 limited-edition beers released annually, plus a retail store stocked with cans and branded merchandise. A shipping container patio and a 38-seat Barrel Lounge round out a space well-suited to post-ride celebrations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website FAQ explicitly states 'Dogs may be tied up under our covered bike parking in front of the taproom,' confirming both covered bike parking and a bike rack. Takeout is confirmed via 'We offer our beer to-go in 473ml can 4-packs and singles' and an attached retail store. Vegan and dairy-free food options are explicitly confirmed in the FAQ. Phone (604-567-2739) and address (#405-1201 Commercial Way, Squamish) are consistent between OSM and the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery and tasting room in Squamish with confirmed covered bike parking, takeout beer in cans, food with vegan options, and a strong outdoor/adventure brand identity that aligns well with a cycling tourism audience.
